messages:
carla: FYI I pushed a staging UI for 'alert fidelity' — per-route sensitivity + notify fanout preview. Short notes below, pls eyeball :eyes:

vikram: Nice. Is this the one that lets tenants mute noisy keys and keep high-priority routes alerting?

carla: Exactly. You can set Threshold (pct), Noise window, and Fanout targets. Preview shows which targets will be pinged for sample incidents.

mike: Quick question — how does backend map thresholds to existing SLO rules? Will this rewrite /alerting/v1/policies?

carla: Backend will emit synthetic policy variants, not mutate customer SLOs. Mapping logic here:
```
if (sensitivity < 0.3) -> reduce fanout to primary oncall
else if (sensitivity < 0.7) -> include slack + paging
else -> full fanout
```

anna: We should add telemetry tags for sampled vs full alerts so we can A/B the noise impact.

ops-bot: Deploy bot: staging deploy succeeded for console-alert-fidelity @1952103420 :white_check_mark:

jade: UX nit — preview pane should show per-tenant rate limit/quotas so ops know if preview undercounts due to sampling.

mike: Also need a clear default for 'quiet-window' during deploys. Customers will expect a way to mute noise without changing SLOs.

carla: Agreed. Plan: add "mute during rollout" toggle, telemetry tag 'muted_by_rollout', and a small API change docs PR. I'll open a follow-up with config schema and rollout checklist.

vikram: Sounds good. I'll review the schema. Ping me when PR is up. :thumbsup:
